I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and 1280px width are unchecked.

It has the "Notifications" heading, the "Mark All as Read" button and the six notifications. The first three are unread. Unread rows are marked with a pale blue background, a blue dot and bolder text. Screen readers also get a hidden "Unread:" prefix on those rows.

I followed `DESIGN.md` for colors, type sizes, spacing, radii and the pill button. I also added a small "Harbor" label above the heading, which wasn't in your content list, so delete it if you want the content exactly as given.

The design calls for the Unbounded and Archivo fonts, but the folder has no font files and the page can't load them from elsewhere. It names them first in the font stack and falls back to system sans-serif, so the heading will look different until the fonts are installed.

`session.json` was empty, and `session.err` only contained an "unrecognized_model" log line, so neither affected the build.
